title: Juicy Sweet Brazilian Pear Gratin
description: A salty, molten, comforting Brazilian dish featuring pears and shio-cure, diabetic-friendly and delicious.
instructions: Peel, core, and slice the pears into 1/4 inch thick pieces.
In a large bowl, whisk together the shio-cure salt, brown sugar, and cinnamon.
Add the sliced pears to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the sugar mixture.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the heavy cream, eggs, and vanilla extract.
In a 9x9 inch baking dish, create a layer of pears, then pour some of the cream mixture over the pears, and repeat this process until all ingredients are used, ending with a layer of cream on top.
Dot the top of the gratin with the unsalted butter.
Bake the gratin in the preheated oven for 35 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the pears are tender.
